I am sixty years now and I have farmed these lands since I was a girl following my mother. For this beans plot, I will not buy chemical fertilizer because it costs too much and beans grow well enough with the manure I spread from our animals. I keep my own seed from last harvest — I know it, and it has never failed me. It is only my children and me working the land, so we will put in about seventy days between planting, weeding, and picking, but I cannot pay hired workers this season.
